sourceNote: Subway Germany's Allergene und Nährwerte page (https://www.subway.com/de-DE/MenuNutrition/Nutrition) links its nutrition as a PDF, "Germany Nutritional Information Full Menu C4 2026" (three pages, made from an Excel sheet on 7 August 2026, headed "Nährwertinformationen September 2026 Deutschland"). It states per portion, with the portion weight, and per 100 g: energy in kJ and kcal, fat, saturated fat, carbohydrate, sugar, fibre, protein and salt. The values include the recommended bread or wrap, the chosen protein, the standard vegetables and sauce in the standard build; a sub is the 15 cm one, and the sheet says to double the values for a Footlong (salads excepted). Every row records the PDF page it stands on, the PDF address and its SHA-256. Where a stated per-100 value contradicts the portion's own figure, kJ against kcal decides the energy, the energy decides fat, carbohydrate and protein, and fibre, sugar, saturated fat and salt follow the side the energy chose or are left out when nothing decides; a row whose energy no check settles is left out. The energy must then fit the macronutrients (9 kcal per g fat, 4 per g carbohydrate and protein, 2 per g fibre, within 20 % or 12 kcal); a fibre figure that alone breaks the fit is left out, a row that still does not fit is left out, and a salt figure above 10 g per 100 g outside a sauce is left out. Each such row says so in valueNotes.
